Initial setup
-------------

For this tutorial, I'm using a lightly modified version of susieR that
can be installed from the "output_residuals" branch:

```{r install-susie, eval=FALSE}
library(remotes)
install_github("stephenslab/susieR@output_residuals")
```

Load all the packages used in the tutorial:

```{r load-pkgs}
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(susieR)
packageVersion("susieR")
```

Set the seed for reproducibility:

```{r set-seed}
set.seed(1)
```

```{r manhattan-plot, fig.height=2, fig.width=5}
manhattan_plot <- function (pval, xlab = "") {
  n <- length(pval)
  dat <- data.frame(pos = 1:n,pval = -log10(pval))
  return(ggplot(dat,aes(x = pos,y = pval)) +
         geom_point() +
		 scale_x_continuous(breaks = NULL) +
		 labs(x = xlab,y = "-log10 p-value") +
         theme_cowplot(font_size = 12))
}
manhattan_plot(pval,xlab = "SNPs on human chromosome 1 near the FMO2 gene")
```
